profile.headline: Software Engineer at Alianza, Inc.
profile.summary:
I am a hardworking, persistent, and self-driven employee, with 4 years experience as a Front-end Software Developer and a strong desire to learn and improve new skills and perfect old ones. I strive to help coworkers and customers have positive experiences by improving processes and resolving problems, and by being patient and amicable under stress. I enjoy working hard to do what needs to be done, or learning the skills to do so.

I have experience coding in Java, C#, Javascript, Typescript, HTML, CSS, Angular, HTTP, and using gRPC calls over the web as well as some experience with C++ and Unity.

I am proud of my ability to learn quickly, as I managed to learn all the necessary skills for front-end development during my first post-graduate internship and was able to start programming and contributing quickly.

I am a University of Utah Graduate with a BA in Mandarin Chinese and a Minor in Computer Science.
